description: This file is a Go source code file that generates API functions for TensorFlow operations by parsing operation definitions and API definitions, and producing Go wrapper functions for them. It includes code for unmarshalling protobuf messages, handling operation attributes and arguments, and templating the generation of source code functions.

classes.name: attrWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper struct for operation attribute definitions, providing methods to access attribute properties.

classes.name: argWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper struct for operation argument definitions, providing methods to access argument properties.

classes.name: tmplArgs
classes.description: Data structure holding all template arguments for generating a Go wrapper function for an operation, including inputs, outputs, attributes, and associated API definitions.

methods.name: newTmplArgs
methods.description: Constructs a tmplArgs instance for a given operation and its API definition, organizing inputs, outputs, and attributes for code generation.

methods.name: goType
methods.description: Converts a TensorFlow type string into corresponding Go type, handling lists and scalar types.

methods.name: identifier
methods.description: Generates a valid Go identifier, avoiding conflicts with keywords and reserved names.

methods.name: marshalProtoMessage
methods.description: Serializes a protobuf message to a string for use as default value representation in generated code.
